SELECT w_state, i_item_id, 
       SUM(CASE WHEN d_date < '2001-05-02' THEN cs_sales_price - COALESCE(cr_refunded_cash, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS sales_before, 
       SUM(CASE WHEN d_date >= '2001-05-02' THEN cs_sales_price - COALESCE(cr_refunded_cash, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS sales_after 
FROM (
    SELECT cs.*, d.d_date
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN date_dim d
    ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    WHERE d.d_date BETWEEN '2001-04-02' AND '2001-06-01'
) AS filtered_sales
JOIN item 
  ON item.i_item_sk = filtered_sales.cs_item_sk 
  AND item.i_current_price BETWEEN 0.99 AND 1.49
LEFT OUTER JOIN catalog_returns 
  ON (filtered_sales.cs_order_number = cr_order_number AND filtered_sales.cs_item_sk = cr_item_sk) 
JOIN warehouse 
  ON filtered_sales.cs_warehouse_sk = warehouse.w_warehouse_sk 
GROUP BY w_state, i_item_id 
ORDER BY w_state, i_item_id 
LIMIT 100
